scenes.text: Google turns any PDF into a *60-second video*, free

scenes.title: What *changed*
lines: Gemini Notebook added Short Video Overviews: about 60 seconds, 80+ languages, narration plus animation.
Rolling out since Sept 15 to personal Google accounts too. Source: Google Workspace Updates, Sept 18, 2026.

scenes.title: The *money* use
lines: Drop in a public report or your own notes. Get an explainer video in about a minute.
Faceless education pages sell exactly this: summaries, study shorts, niche how-tos.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: Platforms demonetize mass-produced AI video. Add your own angle and edit, and label it AI.
Only use sources you have the right to use.

scenes.title: The *cost*
lines: Free with a personal Google account.
Students: 12 months of Google AI free, with higher limits.

scenes.text: Comment *NOTEBOOK* and I'll post the 3-step setup.
